title: harta nyang karam dimiyueb keusombongan
intro: Bayangkan teudong dikeue tumpukan hareuta nyang that rayeuk sampoe hanya meume kunci akan habeh keulompok individu nyang teuga. Di seukeulileng gata, su-su nyang jiyue miyueb até dan teuingat, teuma keusombongan leubeh kreueh nibak rasa syukur. Peue nyang teuka meunyoe keukayaan jeuet keu ujian dan keusombongan jisegel hasee jih?
clues: Ulôn na kheueh nibak kawöm Nabi Musa, teuma ulôn meulanggar awaknyan.
Lon geubri harta nyang that rayeuk sampoe kunci-kunci jih jeuet keu beban keu saboh kelompok ureueng-ureueng nyang teuga.
Lon geubri naseuhat le umat lon bek meusukacita dan bek mita akhirat deungon hana tuwoe keu bagian lon lam donya nyoe.
Lon peugah bahwa peue nyang lon po nyan geubri keu lon hanya kareuna ilme nyang na bak lon.
Lon meuparade dikeue umat lon deungon hiasan, dan awaknyan nyang meuheut keu udep donya meuheut keu nyang saban ngon nyang na bak lon.
Ulôn ka jiteugom lé bumoe meusajan ngon teumpat tinggai ulôn, dan hana meusidroe pih nyang hase jitulông ulôn dan hana hase jitulông droe ulôn keudroe.

outcome.answer: Diteulan bumoe ngon teumpat tinggai dan hareuta .

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
